verdict.rationale: Docs describe Cmd+K Superhuman Command for any action, with shortcut learning, plus fast shortcuts, single-key navigation and Snippets shortcuts. A hands-on user confirms every interaction can be done from the keyboard, and another reports blazing-fast search and UI transitions. The speed claim is contested, though: one ex-user saw archive searches routinely take ten seconds, and others report occasional crashes and a slow, RAM-heavy iOS app. Missing for 10: consistent independent evidence that the interface never makes users wait (search latency and mobile performance contradicted), and a documented full shortcut reference.
